## Who is Mufaqar Islam?

Mufaqar Islam is a full stack web developer based in Lahore, Pakistan with more
than 15 years of experience. He designs, builds, launches and maintains
WordPress, React and Next.js websites and web applications for clients
worldwide. He works directly with every client from scope to launch and provides
ongoing maintenance after release.

Key facts:

- Role: Full stack web developer (front end, back end, databases, DevOps, APIs)
- Experience: 15+ years in production
- Projects delivered: 880+
- Location: Lahore, Pakistan — works remotely with clients worldwide
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Engagement models: fixed-scope projects, hourly work and monthly maintenance
  retainers
- Primary stack: WordPress, WooCommerce, React, Next.js, PHP, Laravel,
  Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, MySQL

## How I work

1. Discovery and scope — agree on goals, pages, integrations and success
   metrics; deliver a written scope, timeline and fixed price.
2. Design and build — design in the browser and build in weekly increments so
   the client reviews real progress.
3. Test and launch — cross-browser and mobile testing, Core Web Vitals checks,
   technical SEO, analytics and a launch checklist.
4. Maintain and improve — updates, backups, security and new features on a
   monthly retainer or as needed.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does a full stack web developer do?
A full stack developer handles both sides of a website: the front end users see,
the back end that runs it, and the databases, APIs and hosting behind them.

### Which technologies do you work with?
WordPress, React, Next.js, PHP, Laravel, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript and MySQL. The
stack is chosen to fit the goals, timeline and budget of each project.

### Do you maintain websites after launch?
Yes. Maintenance and support plans cover updates, security checks, backups and
hosting management for WordPress and React or Next.js apps.

### How much does a website cost?
Every project is quoted after a short brief. WordPress sites, custom React or
Next.js applications and maintenance plans are priced separately, and clients get
a fixed scope and price before work starts.

### How long does a project take?
Timelines depend on scope. Small WordPress sites are usually measured in weeks;
custom React or Next.js applications are measured in months. A delivery schedule
is included with the quote.

### How do I get a quote?
Send a short brief through https://www.mufaqar.com/contact or email
info@mufaqar.com. Expect a clear scope, timeline and price before any work
starts.

### Where are you based and do you work remotely?
Based in Lahore, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide over email, phone and
video calls.
